startup.dbErrorBody: Your records are still there. Please don't reinstall the app — update to the latest version and open it again.

onboarding.title: Pick one to start
onboarding.body: Just tap to add it. You can change the name and frequency later.

form.name: Name
form.deleteBody: Its records and notes will be deleted and can't be restored. To keep them, export from Settings first.
form.limitedHint: Set an end date, like a 30-day challenge. When it ends, the habit leaves Today and its records stay in Review.

kinds.checkHint: One tap logs it as done.
kinds.countHint: Add up amounts until you reach the goal (e.g. 2000 ml of water).
kinds.limitHint: Done as long as you stay under the limit (e.g. up to 3 drinks a week).

schedule.restHint: On sick days or trips, mark a rest day. Rest days never break your streak.

entry.restHint: Rest days keep your streak going.
entry.notePlaceholder: How it went, anything you noticed

detail.restLegend: Filled squares are done days; hollow squares are rest days.
detail.editHint: Tap a date to fix a record or write a note.
detail.noNotes: Notes you add after logging will show up here.

review.title: Review
review.empty: Log your habits and your completion rates will show up here.

stats.detailedHint: See your year at a glance, your best and hardest days and times, and how you compare with last year.

share.title: Share
share.failed: Couldn't create the image. Please try again.

me.title: Me
me.freeBody: Unlimited habits, free logging forever. See what Pro adds
me.storage: Your records are stored on this device
me.noExport: Export now and then so you're ready when you change phones.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dayStartFooter: If you stay up late or work nights, a later start puts after-midnight logs on the same day.
settings.celebrationsDetail: Shows a card once at milestones like 7, 30 and 100 days
settings.summaryDetail: Once a day, tells you how many habits are on today
settings.storageNote: Your records stay on this device and are never sent anywhere. Exports include your notes.

import.formatHint: Ongo JSON files and CSV files with a date column are supported.
import.mergeNote: These will be added to your records. Records for the same day will be replaced with the file's.
import.failed: Couldn't import. Your records haven't changed.

notifications.logBody: Log today's amount when you're ready
notifications.card: Allow notifications to get reminders at the times you choose
notifications.deniedCard: Notifications are off. You can turn them on in your device settings

reviewPrompt.title: Enjoying Ongo?
reviewPrompt.body: A rating on the {{store}} really helps us keep improving.

pro.title: Pro
pro.lead: Unlimited habits and logging are free forever. Pro adds ways to make Ongo your own — the things you want once you really use it.
pro.active: Pro is active. Thank you for your support.
pro.freeForever: Logging, undo, fixing past days, rest days and exports are always free — no Pro needed. No ads, ever.

featureBodies.themes: Recolor the whole app with 10 themes
featureBodies.colors: Pick from 6 colors for each habit
featureBodies.icons: Every icon, emoji, and your own photos
featureBodies.repeat: Every N days, N times a month, Nth weekday, N days after done, limited periods
featureBodies.reminders: As many as you like per habit, different times per weekday
featureBodies.stats: Your year, best and hardest days and times, and last year compared
featureBodies.cards: Colors and layouts for share cards

pro.subscriptionNote: Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically at the same price unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Cancel anytime under Subscriptions in your {{store}} account settings.
pro.regionalNote: Prices vary by country or region. Prices shown are for your region.
pro.unavailable: Purchases aren't available right now. Check your connection and try again later.
pro.storeNote: Purchases are tied to your store account. On a new phone, tap “Restore purchases.”
pro.thanks: Thank you! Pro is now unlocked.
pro.pending: Waiting for purchase approval. Pro will unlock once it's approved.
pro.purchaseFailed: The purchase didn't go through. You haven't been charged.
pro.restoreNothing: No purchases to restore were found.
pro.gateBody: You can keep logging for free, just as you are.

widget.empty: Add a habit in the app to log it here
widget.proLarge: The large widget is available with Pro
widget.name: Today's habits
widget.lockDescription: How many are done and what is next
widget.controlDescription: Log the habit you choose with one tap

icloud.footer: When you leave the app and your records have changed, they are saved to the “Ongo” folder in iCloud Drive (one per day). On a new phone, use “Restore from iCloud.”
icloud.unavailable: iCloud isn't available. Sign in to iCloud and turn on iCloud Drive in your device settings.
icloud.restoreFooter: The selected backup's records will be added to your current records.
icloud.readFailed: Couldn't read the backup. Check your connection.
icloud.emptySkipped: There are no records yet, so nothing was backed up.

archive.hint: Removes it from Today, reminders and widgets. Your records stay, and you can bring it back anytime.
archive.title: Archived habits
archive.footer: When you restore a habit, the days it was archived become rest days, so your streak keeps going.

vacation.title: Rest days for all
vacation.lead: Traveling or not feeling well? Pick a period to make it a rest day for every habit. Days you already logged stay as they are.
vacation.nothing: There were no days to make rest days.
vacation.clear: Cancel rest days in this period
vacation.clearBody: Days you logged stay as they are.
vacation.nothingToClear: There were no rest days to cancel.

lock.settingDetail: Ask for Face ID or your passcode when opening
lock.footer: Widgets and the Lock Screen are not locked. Logging from a reminder button requires unlocking your device.
lock.title: Locked
lock.unavailable: Not available on this device. Set up Face ID or a passcode in your device settings.
